provenance: TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM from Section 6.3 of 'The Open-Weight Collections Agent Challenge' v1.0 (28 August 2026). The specification states: 'Fixed for the challenge. Do not modify -- comparability depends on everyone using the same schemas.'
modification_policy: DO NOT MODIFY. Property names, types, enum members and required lists are reproduced exactly as published. No constraints have been added -- in particular `additionalProperties` is deliberately ABSENT because the published schemas do not set it, and adding it would change what counts as a malformed call relative to every other team's harness. The only structural change is the OpenAI-style {type: function, function: {...}} envelope, which is how both Ollama and vLLM accept tools; the inner object is untouched.

changelog.change: Replaced the v1.0.0 schemas, which were authored for this repository before the specification PDF was available and did not match it. Every argument signature changed. All results collected under v1.0.0 are void.
